findings.body: Raise: Test. The uncommitted invalid forge.toml edit at line 155 is layered on top of a committed change. The test would still pass if the uncommitted restore were removed, because the committed restore checks out the handout version. It also checks the final file and clean status without proving the committed edit was reversed in a new commit. Earlier, the second handback occurs while work is still uncommitted; the test commits only afterward, so it never proves the named handback-after-commit path. These Done-when outcomes need independent command-level assertions.
findings.title: Not done: prove settings restoration and the post-nudge handback
